subject.title: feat(agents): inject Recently Completed Subagents into parent prompt

question: Should all existing parent-agent orchestrations receive recently completed child-run metadata by default for 120 minutes, rather than retaining the prior 30-minute prompt-context horizon?
rationale: The patch changes the default prompt payload for established agent workflows; tests establish formatting but cannot determine the intended trade-off between duplicate-spawn prevention, stale context, and prompt budget.

options.title: Adopt the 120-minute default
options.body: Accept the longer completion anchor after a real runtime trace demonstrates the intended parent behavior and acceptable prompt payload.

options.title: Keep the existing 30-minute default
options.body: Add recent-run injection but preserve the former default horizon unless maintainers want a separately calibrated configuration/default change.

recommendation.title: Keep the existing 30-minute default
recommendation.body: Add recent-run injection but preserve the former default horizon unless maintainers want a separately calibrated configuration/default change.

likelyOwner.reason: Their documented recent work on nested subagent orchestration is the closest established ownership signal for this lifecycle and prompt-context decision.
